ruleDefinitions.name: Dumping Process via Sqldumper.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects process dump via legitimate sqldumper.exe binary

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\sqldumper\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*0x0110.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*0x01100\\:40.*")))
